title: Override label row (ap/0.2 normative shape)
description: MUST-field schema for every JSON object line in labels/overrides.jsonl (STANDARD.md 'Override label row' section). Enforced by the ap-gate check labels_row_shape. Open-world by design like manifest.schema.json: unknown fields are always allowed. reason_text and evidence_refs are declared here but NOT required in core - a 'training-grade' profile opts into requiring reason_text (see profiles/<name>/training_grade.json, src/ap_gate/profiles.py). agent_draft is optional and opt-in (P4): a package with model_run.role set is advised, not required, to carry it on every row, via the agent_draft_present check; a training-grade profile may escalate that to required too.

evidence_refs.description: Whole-file/URI refs, optionally with a '#rows=col:val[,col:val...]' fragment (P3, STANDARD.md) pointing at a specific slice. SHOULD only - fragment-less whole-file refs remain valid.

agent_draft.description: Optional (P4): the pair agent's draft suggestion before the human's accepted override landed in this row. Opt-in, covered by the same training_eligibility policy as the rest of the package.
